description_en: Queries the progress of a post-processing task for a rule library. Use this operation together with the ConfirmAndPostProcessAuditNote operation to check the status of the current post-processing task
description_zh: 查询规则库后处理的进度。与 ConfirmAndPostProcessAuditNote 接口配合使用，供您查询当前后处理任务的状态
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi get-audit-note-post-processing-status --workspace-id llm-xx --task-id xxx_Default_12847192741412 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuditNotePostProcessingStatus

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html

parameters.help_en: The task ID returned by the SubmitAuditNote operation. This is the unique identifier for the task index of the custom rule library. Save this ID for future use
